hypotheses.storyTitle: Defend the Streak and Climb the Ranks
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Marcus checks his mobile rewards dashboard to maintain his 34-day streak and secure his top-3 leaderboard rank.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Active daily user with a 34-day streak and rank #3 on the community leaderboard.
hypotheses.storyTension: Maintaining daily streak continuity and defending leaderboard position against active peers.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Engaging with quick daily challenges to protect the streak and earn milestone badges.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Maintain engagement and satisfaction through recognized progress, active streaks, and community standing.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Marcus explores upcoming community events and available challenges to earn his next tier of achievement badges.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Holder of 15 badges looking for new gamified goals to conquer.
hypotheses.storyTension: Identifying the next high-value challenge to maintain progression momentum.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Reviewing active challenges and community event participation options.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Sustain motivation through new badge discovery and challenge completion.
